course.title: Unit 8 Once upon a Time【例句】
course.description: Section A What are your favourite stories?

sentences.content: What are the students in the photo doing?
sentences.english: What are the students in the photo doing ?
sentences.chinese: 照片中的学生们在做什么？

sentences.content: How do you think they feel about it?
sentences.english: How do you think they feel about it ?
sentences.chinese: 你认为他们对这件事有什么看法？

sentences.content: What do you think the teacher is helping them with?
sentences.english: What do you think the teacher is helping them with ?
sentences.chinese: 你认为老师正在帮助他们做什么？

sentences.content: Please share your favourite story with me, Peter.
sentences.english: Please share your favourite story with me , Peter
sentences.chinese: Peter，请和我分享你最喜欢的故事。

sentences.content: Sure. Once a lion caught a mouse.
sentences.english: Sure . Once a lion caught a mouse
sentences.chinese: 好的。有一次，狮子抓到了一只老鼠。

sentences.content: The mouse was afraid.
sentences.english: The mouse was afraid
sentences.chinese: 老鼠很害怕。

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时态

sentences.content: He said, “Please let me go! One day I will help you.”
sentences.english: He said ," Please let me go ! One day I will help you ."
sentences.chinese: 他说：“请放我走吧！总有一天我会帮你的。”

sentences.content: The lion laughed and let the mouse go.
sentences.english: The lion laughed and let the mouse go
sentences.chinese: 狮子笑了笑，放走了老鼠。

sentences.content: Later, a hunter caught the lion in a net.
sentences.english: Later , a hunter caught the lion in a net
sentences.chinese: 后来，一位猎人用网捕获了这头狮子。

sentences.content: The mouse helped the lion then.
sentences.english: The mouse helped the lion then
sentences.chinese: 老鼠随后帮助了狮子。

sentences.content: He bit through the net and set the lion free!
sentences.english: He bit through the net and set the lion free !
sentences.chinese: 他咬破网子，把狮子放了出来！

sentences.content: I like that story.
sentences.english: I like that story
sentences.chinese: 我喜欢这个故事。

sentences.content: Kindness is never wasted.
sentences.english: Kindness is never wasted
sentences.chinese: 善意从不会被浪费。

sentences.content: What’s your favourite story, Teng Fei?
sentences.english: What's your favourite story , Teng Fei ?
sentences.chinese: Teng Fei，你最喜欢的故事是什么？

sentences.content: Oh, I like this one.
sentences.english: Oh , I like this one
sentences.chinese: 哦，我喜欢这个。

sentences.content: A farmer lost his horse.
sentences.english: A farmer lost his horse
sentences.chinese: 一位农夫丢失了他的马。

sentences.content: His neighbours said, “How unlucky!”
sentences.english: His neighbours said ," How unlucky !"
sentences.chinese: 他的邻居们说：“真倒霉！”

sentences.content: But the farmer just said, “Maybe.”
sentences.english: But the farmer just said ," Maybe ."
sentences.chinese: 但农夫只是说，“也许吧。”

sentences.content: Later, his horse came back with seven other horses.
sentences.english: Later , his horse came back with seven other horses
sentences.chinese: 后来，他的马带着另外七匹马回来了。

sentences.content: People said, “That’s great!”
sentences.english: People said ," That's great !"
sentences.chinese: 人们说：“太棒了！”

sentences.content: But the farmer said, “Maybe.”
sentences.english: But the farmer said ," Maybe ."
sentences.chinese: 但农夫说道：“也许吧。”

sentences.content: Later, his son broke his leg when he tried to ride a horse.
sentences.english: Later , his son broke his leg when he tried to ride a horse
sentences.chinese: 后来，他的儿子在尝试骑马时摔断了腿。

sentences.content: People said, “That’s terrible!”
sentences.english: People said ," That's terrible !"
sentences.chinese: 人们说：“这太糟糕了！”

sentences.content: Again, the farmer said, “Maybe.”
sentences.english: Again , the farmer said ," Maybe ."
sentences.chinese: 农夫再次说道：“也许吧。”

sentences.content: Well, because of his leg, the son didn’t have to join a war.
sentences.english: Well , because of his leg , the son didn't have to join a war
sentences.chinese: 由于他的腿伤，儿子不必参军参战。

sentences.content: That saved his life!
sentences.english: That saved his life !
sentences.chinese: 这救了他的命！

sentences.content: I see.
sentences.english: I see
sentences.chinese: 我明白了。

sentences.content: Unlucky things may turn out well.
sentences.english: Unlucky things may turn out well
sentences.chinese: 塞翁失马，焉知非福。

sentences.content: And good things could go wrong too.
sentences.english: And good things could go wrong too
sentences.chinese: 好事也可能变糟。

sentences.content: Once upon a time, an emperor liked clothes very much.
sentences.english: Once upon a time , an emperor liked clothes very much
sentences.chinese: 从前，有一位皇帝非常喜欢衣服。

sentences.content: He wanted to buy some new clothes.
sentences.english: He wanted to buy some new clothes
sentences.chinese: 他想买些新衣服。

sentences.content: Two brothers came and lied to him, “We can make wonderful clothes!
sentences.english: Two brothers came and lied to him ," We can make wonderful clothes !
sentences.chinese: 两兄弟过来对他撒谎说：“我们能做出绝妙的衣服！

sentences.content: But only clever people can see them!”
sentences.english: But only clever people can see them !"
sentences.chinese: 但只有聪明人才能看见它们！

sentences.content: They pretended to make the clothes.
sentences.english: They pretended to make the clothes
sentences.chinese: 他们假装在做衣服。

sentences.content: The emperor’s officials couldn’t see the clothes, but they said, “What lovely clothes!”
sentences.english: The emperor's officials couldn't see the clothes , but they said ," What lovely clothes !"
sentences.chinese: 皇帝的官员们看不见衣服，但他们却说：“多么漂亮的衣服啊！”

sentences.content: The emperor couldn’t see anything either, but he said, “They’re beautiful!”
sentences.english: The emperor couldn't see anything either , but he said ," They're beautiful !"
sentences.chinese: 皇帝也什么都看不见，但他却说：“它们美极了！”

sentences.content: No one wanted to look silly.
sentences.english: No one wanted to look silly
sentences.chinese: 没人想出洋相。

sentences.content: The emperor decided to show everyone his new clothes.
sentences.english: The emperor decided to show everyone his new clothes
sentences.chinese: 皇帝决定向众人展示他的新衣服。

sentences.content: People in the street praised them.
sentences.english: People in the street praised them
sentences.chinese: 街上的人们称赞了他们。

sentences.content: They were afraid to look silly too!
sentences.english: They were afraid to look silly too !
sentences.chinese: 他们也怕看起来傻乎乎的！

wordDetails.definition: be（过去式）: 构成过去时态

sentences.content: Suddenly, a boy shouted, “Look! The emperor has no clothes on!”
sentences.english: Suddenly , a boy shouted ," Look ! The emperor has no clothes on !"
sentences.chinese: 突然，一个男孩喊道：“快看！皇帝没穿衣服！”

wordDetails.definition: have（第三人称单数现在时）: 有

sentences.content: Everyone looked at one another.
sentences.english: Everyone looked at one another
sentences.chinese: 众人面面相觑。

sentences.content: They started laughing.
sentences.english: They started laughing
sentences.chinese: 他们笑了起来。
